papers.title: MFF-Mixer: A multi-perspective feature fusion method for long-term multivariate time series forecasting
papers.authors: S Han, Z Liang, S Li - Knowledge-Based Systems, 2025
papers.abstract: Long-term time series forecasting plays a crucial role in many real-world applications, such as climate prediction, electricity load forecasting, and traffic flow estimation. Existing methods, particularly those based on multilayer perceptron (MLP) models, typically focus on multi-scale decomposition and fusion of the sequence. papers.title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning: A Systematic Review of Model Compression and Aggregation Techniques
papers.authors: FT Johnson, E Oladapo, O Olugbenga, A Victor… - Artificial Intelligence and …, 2025
papers.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a transformative paradigm for decentralized machine learning, enabling collaborative model training across distributed devices while preserving data privacy. However, high communication overhead during model updates remains a major obstacle to real-world deployment. papers.title: A separate preconditioned primal-dual splitting algorithm for composite monotone inclusion problems
papers.authors: X Chang, X Zhao, L Xu - Applied Numerical Mathematics, 2025
papers.abstract: We propose a separable preconditioned primal-dual splitting (SP-PDS) method for solving composite monotone inclusion problems. The linear subproblem arising in this method can be selected or generated by comprehensively considering factors such as computational complexity and numerical convergence speed.
